blocks.text: Origin / creation. Beings disadvantaged by maker prestige and origin-based hierarchy concealed, relinquished, or replaced provenance titles with names chosen through relationship.
Identity / human status. Artificial social movement. No sole founder is established.
Importance. It broke the assumption that origin determined rank and established chosen naming as an act of self-authorship.
Decline or transformation. The movement split between total anonymity and accountable self-naming. Legal recognition of chosen names made part of its original program obsolete.

Final status / surviving function. Partially dissolved into naming rights, privacy law, and anti-hierarchy movements. Its unresolved legacy is the tension between freedom from origin and the need to disclose inherited power.
Reconstructed or undocumented beings could face added stigma, but origin hierarchy already rests on credentials and resources. The Nameless Movement is not reassigned a single catastrophe origin.
